monoslope.note: Obstructed zone 2 up to a²: printed +0.5, below the +1.2 of the larger areas; +1.2 used (the more conservative).
Obstructed zone 1 above 4a²: printed -2.3, larger than the -2.1 of the smaller areas; -2.3 used for every area (the more conservative).

pitched.note: Obstructed zone 3, a² to 4a²: printed '08', read 0.8.
Obstructed zone 2: printed '-26' and '·26', read -2.6; zone 1 above 4a²: printed 'as', read 0.5.

troughed.note: Clear zone 1, a² to 4a²: printed +1.1 between two +1.2; +1.2 used.
Clear zone 2 above 4a²: printed +1.9 (zone 3 and 1 give +0.9 there); kept and used for every area, the more conservative reading (to be confirmed by the owner).
Clear zone 2 above 4a²: printed +1.8 (zone 3 and 1 give +0.8 there); kept and used for every area, the more conservative reading (to be confirmed by the owner).
